annotations.title: Find the company behind a website

description: Find the Romanian firm behind a website domain (dedeman.ro). Uses the registry's website field, else reads the site's home and legal/contact pages for the CUI or registration number it shows (matchedOn: registry_website, site_cui). Without one, it says so and offers name candidates from the page title or the domain name, each with a confidence (at most 0.7, never a match). One lookup.

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

domain.description: The website's domain ('dedeman.ro'); a URL or a www. host is reduced to it. Public domains only.
domain.title: Domain

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

name: find_company_by_domain

outputSchema.description: The firm behind a website domain, or why none was found.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

candidates.description: When not found (also when the site cannot be read): up to 3 firms whose name matches the page title or the domain name, each with a confidence (at most 0.7).

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

fields.description: The company fields kept when fields or compact trimmed the rows.

match.description: The identified firm: cui, companyName, matchedOn.

reason.description: When not found: no_cui_on_site or site_unreachable.

items.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address, county, city, website, phone, caenActivities [{code, activity (RO), activityEn}], directors, representatives [{name, role}], status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, url (the firm's public record page to share with the user; null for sole traders and other natural persons), and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys (compact keeps url).

site.description: What was read from the site: url, pagesRead, title, cuis, registrationCodes, error.

total.description: Number of company records returned (at most 5).

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

title: Find the company behind a website
